title: File response built from a runtime path in python — review required
description: send_file with a value that is not a literal passes a runtime path straight to the response. If that value includes request data and is not normalised, ../ segments or absolute paths escape the intended directory. The rule flags the non-literal call; whether the path is constrained is a review decision.
remediation: Resolve the requested name against a fixed base with safe_join, reject traversal, and serve only regular files.
limitation: Lexical: matches a non-literal first argument; a helper that validates the path is not seen.
